# Copying Objects

1. Write a class `Student` with three fields: `name` (String), `age` (int) and `grade` (double). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Student` object, clone it, and then change the grade (`grade`) of the original student. Display the grades of both students to see whether they are independent.

2. Write a class `Teacher` with three fields: `name` (String), `subject` (String) and `experience` (int). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Teacher` object, clone it, and then change the experience (`experience`) of the original teacher. Display the experience of both teachers to see whether they are independent.

3. Write a class `Car` with three fields: `make` (String), `model` (String) and `mileage` (double). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Car` object, clone it, and then change the mileage (`mileage`) of the original car. Display the mileage of both cars to see whether they are independent.

4. Write a class `Smartphone` with three fields: `brand` (String), `model` (String) and `productionDate` (of type `Date`). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Smartphone` object, clone it, and then change the production date of the original smartphone. Display the production date of both smartphones to see whether they are independent.

5. Write a class `Laptop` with three fields: `brand` (String), `model` (String) and `purchaseDate` (of type `Date`). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Laptop` object, clone it, and then change the purchase date (`purchaseDate`) of the original laptop. Display the purchase date of both laptops to see whether they are independent.

6. Write a class `VideoGame` with three fields: `title` (String), `genre` (String) and `releaseDate` (of type `Date`). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `VideoGame` object, clone it, and then change the release date (`releaseDate`) of the original game. Display the release date of both games to see whether they are independent.

7. Write a class `CreditCard` with three fields: `cardNumber` (String), `holderName` (String) and `expiryDate` (of type `LocalDate`). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `CreditCard` object, clone it, and then change the expiry date (`expiryDate`) of the original credit card. Display the expiry date of both cards to see whether they are independent.

8. Write a class `BankAccount` with three fields: `accountNumber` (String), `accountHolder` (String) and `openingDate` (of type `LocalDate`). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `BankAccount` object, clone it, and then change the opening date (`openingDate`) of the original bank account. Display the opening date of both accounts to see whether they are independent.

9. Write a class `DrivingLicense` with three fields: `licenseNumber` (String), `holderName` (String) and `issueDate` (of type `LocalDate`). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `DrivingLicense` object, clone it, and then change the issue date (`issueDate`) of the original driving license. Display the issue date of both driving licenses to see whether they are independent.

10. Write a class `Employee` with two fields: `name` (String) and `salaries` (an array of 12 variables of type double, representing the earnings for each month). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create an `Employee` object, clone it, and then change the earnings at position 5 (June) of the original employee. Display the earnings of both employees to see whether they are independent.

11. Write a class `Athlete` with two fields: `name` (String) and `times` (an array of 5 variables of type double, representing the time in seconds needed to run 100 meters in different attempts). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create an `Athlete` object, clone it, and then change the time at position 3 of the original athlete. Display the times of both athletes to see whether they are independent.

12. Write a class `Teacher` with two fields: `name` (String) and `studentsGrades` (an array of 10 variables of type double, representing the grades of each of the 10 students). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Teacher` object, clone it, and then change the grade at position 10 of the original teacher. Display the grades of both teachers to see whether they are independent.

13. Write a class `Employee` with two fields: `name` (String) and `monthlyHours` (an array list of variables of type int, representing the number of hours worked in each month). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create an `Employee` object, clone it, and then change the number of hours at position 5 (June) of the original employee. Display the number of hours of both employees to see whether they are independent.

14. Write a class `Athlete` with two fields: `name` (String) and `lapTimes` (an array list of variables of type int, representing the time in seconds needed to run a lap in different attempts). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create an `Athlete` object, clone it, and then change the time at position 3 of the original athlete. Display the times of both athletes to see whether they are independent.

15. Write a class `Teacher` with two fields: `name` (String) and `studentsGrades` (an array list of variables of type int, representing the grades of each of the students). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method to be able to clone objects of this class. In the `main()` method, create a `Teacher` object, clone it, and then change the grade at position 10 of the original teacher. Display the grades of both teachers to see whether they are independent.

16. Write a class `Teacher` with the fields `name` (String), `age` (int) and `salary` (double). Then write a class `HeadTeacher` that inherits from the `Teacher` class and adds a field `bonus` (double). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method in both classes. In the `main()` method, show an example demonstrating that objects of these classes are cloned correctly.

17. Write a class `Developer` with the fields `name` (String), `age` (int) and `salary` (double). Then write a class `SeniorDeveloper` that inherits from the `Developer` class and adds a field `bonus` (double). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method in both classes. In the `main()` method, show an example demonstrating that objects of these classes are cloned correctly.

18. Write a class `Nurse` with the fields `name` (String), `age` (int) and `salary` (double). Then write a class `HeadNurse` that inherits from the `Nurse` class and adds a field `bonus` (double). Implement the `Cloneable` interface and override the `clone()` method in both classes. In the `main()` method, show an example demonstrating that objects of these classes are cloned correctly.

19. Perform the following steps:

- Create a class `Engine` with the fields `power`, `type` (engine type) and `serialNumber`. Add a parameterized constructor and implement the `Cloneable` interface.
- Create a class `Car`. The `Car` class should have the fields `make`, `model` and `engine` of type `Engine`. Add a parameterized constructor and implement the `Cloneable` interface.
